mapper.select: SELECT s.stu_id, s.stu_name, s.gender, c.class_name, m.major_name AS major, d.dept_name AS dept, s.status, s.class_id FROM student s LEFT JOIN "class" c ON s.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN major m ON c.major_id = m.major_id LEFT JOIN department d ON m.dept_id = d.dept_id ORDER BY s.stu_id
SELECT stu_id, stu_name, gender, dept, major, classname FROM v_student_full_info ORDER BY stu_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (stu_id, stu_name, class_id, gender, status, entry_date) VALUES (#{stuId}, #{stuName}, #{classId}, COALESCE(#{gender}, '男'), #{status}, NOW())
